request.description: Handle job completion webhook from Shunya. The webhook payload contains URLs (summary_url, chunks_url, transcript_url) but NOT the actual analysis data. The backend automatically: 1) Extracts call_id from the payload, 2) Calls Shunya's Summary API (GET /api/v1/call-processing/summary/{call_id}) to fetch the complete analysis data, 3) Stores everything in the database. This simulates the actual webhook format that Shunya sends according to their API documentation.
